source.organization: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services
source.dataset: LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census administrative GIS shapefiles
source.geometry_processing: Mapshaper topology cleaning, topology-aware Douglas-Peucker simplification with keep-shapes, and post-simplification cleaning; interval=150m; derived from geo-counties full-precision geometry

description: Represents a web-generalized version of the 15 county polygon boundaries in the LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census administrative cartography. Source shapefiles use EPSG:32629; published coordinates use EPSG:4326, with topology-aware Douglas-Peucker simplification at 150 meters and shapes preserved. No observation period is assigned: this simplified boundary geometry has a 2022 source vintage but no statistical observation period.
